failure_stop_share.method: sum of FAILURE stop minutes / planned minutes

other_unplanned_share.method: materials + operational + unplanned setup stops / planned minutes (AI does not fix these)

planned_stop_share.method: planned stops counted inside OEE (changeovers, cleaning) / planned minutes

repair_log_sigma.method: standard deviation of log(failure stop duration) - spread of repair times

base_quality.method: mean shift quality rate before improvement

reference_oee_before.method: mean shift OEE before Lean Six Sigma

reference_oee_after.method: mean shift OEE after Lean Six Sigma
